description: This Java source file defines a mock implementation of the Akka Persistent Actor's AsyncWriteJournal interface, primarily used for testing purposes. It logs method calls, forwards certain calls to a Mockito mock object, and simulates different behaviors such as failures or delays.

classes.name: MockJournalPlugin
classes.description: A mock implementation of the AsyncWriteJournal for testing, which logs invocations and can simulate failures or slow responses.

methods.name: doAsyncReplayMessages
methods.description: Logs invocation details and simulates replaying messages, returning a successful Future with null.

methods.name: doAsyncReadHighestSequenceNr
methods.description: Logs invocation details and returns a Future with 0 as the highest sequence number.

methods.name: doAsyncWriteMessages
methods.description: Logs the messages being written and returns a Future with an iterable of empty Optionals, indicating no errors.

methods.name: doAsyncDeleteMessagesTo
methods.description: Logs delete message invocation; forwards call to Mockito mock; can simulate success, failure, or delayed delete based on persistenceId.
